task: Create a polished Apple-style landing page as a single self-contained static HTML file. It should look premium, calm, product-focused, responsive, and ready to inspect in a browser. Do not copy Apple's official page text or logo artwork.
constraints: single HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript only
first viewport must clearly signal the brand and product
use a canvas or CSS-built product visual, not external images
include compact product navigation, hero, feature sections, comparison specs, and buying calls to action
keep total HTML between 5000 and 8000 characters
avoid visible instructions, keyboard shortcut text, and marketing-placeholder copy
buttons and text must not overlap
